facts.what: 全场女人看 Finlay 去点酒；她认定她们都比自己配他
facts.anchor: Any of them would probably be a better match for him than me.

facts.what: 用星座自贬：Cancer 太敏感，不像 Scorpio/Leo 有魅力
facts.anchor: it’s not likely that he’d go for a Cancer like me

facts.what: 自述 18 岁被父母催搬出、25 岁拉黑他们、五年无话
facts.anchor: Five years since I hit block and delete on every contact option available

facts.what: 端回一品脱啤酒、大杯 rosé、高杯粉金酒、四杯满 shot
facts.anchor: a pint of beer, a large glass of rosé wine, a tall pink gin, and four shot glasses

facts.what: 说不知道她想喝什么所以都点了，自称 nice guy
facts.anchor: So, I thought I’d give you a few options. I’m a nice guy like that.

facts.what: 空腹一口闷 sambuca，像毒液烧喉，差点吐出来
facts.anchor: Necking it in one, the liquid I can now identify as sambuca

facts.what: 称他是宇宙礼物、星命灵魂伴侣、唯一能治好她的人
facts.anchor: He’s the one and only thing in this world that could ever cure me.
